welcome.text: Welcome to Post Office Letters! Tap the big envelope to open the mail window.
welcome.heard: Welcome to Post Office Letters! Tap the big envelope to open the mail window.

open-shift.text: The post office is open. Our first customer is here!
open-shift.heard: The post office is open. Our first customer is here.

arrival-maya-leo.text: Maya brought a letter for Leo. Let's write leo on the envelope.
arrival-maya-leo.heard: May I brought a letter for Leo? Let's write Leo on the envelope.

arrival-leo-nia.text: Leo brought a letter for Nia. Let's write nia on the envelope.
arrival-leo-nia.heard: Leo brought a letter for Nia. Let's write Nia on the envelope.

arrival-nia-sam.text: Nia brought a letter for Sam. Let's write sam on the envelope.
arrival-nia-sam.heard: Nia brought a letter for Sam. Let's write Sam on the envelope.

arrival-sam-ravi.text: Sam brought a letter for Ravi. Let's write ravi on the envelope.
arrival-sam-ravi.heard: Sam brought a letter for Ravi. Let's write Ravi on the envelope.

arrival-ravi-maya.text: Ravi brought a letter for Maya. Let's write maya on the envelope.
arrival-ravi-maya.heard: Ravi brought a letter from Maya. Let's write Maya on the envelope.

trace-first.text: Start at the glowing dot and follow the letter trail.
trace-first.heard: Start at the glowing dot and follow the letter trail.

trace-nudge.text: Stay near the glowing trail. Watch where it goes.
trace-nudge.heard: Stay near the glowing trail. Watch where it goes.

next-letter.text: Lovely letter. Now write the next one.
next-letter.heard: Lovely letter. Now write the next one.

name-complete.text: The name is ready. Choose a picture stamp.
name-complete.heard: The name is ready. Choose a picture stamp.

stamp-selected.text: Perfect postage! Now send the letter through the smiling mail chute.
stamp-selected.heard: Perfect postage! Now send the letter through the smiling mail shoot.

send-letter.text: Slide or tap the envelope into the mail chute.
send-letter.heard: Slide or tap the envelope into the mail shoot.

sent.text: Whoosh! The letter is on its way.
sent.heard: Whoosh! The letter is on its way!

pickup-maya.text: Maya is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says maya.
pickup-maya.heard: Maya is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says Maya.

pickup-leo.text: Leo is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says leo.
pickup-leo.heard: Leo is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says Leo.

pickup-nia.text: Nia is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says nia.
pickup-nia.heard: Nia is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says Nia.

pickup-sam.text: Sam is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says sam.
pickup-sam.heard: Sam is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says Sam.

pickup-ravi.text: Ravi is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says ravi.
pickup-ravi.heard: Ravi is here to pick up mail. Find the envelope that says Ravi.

pickup-nudge.text: That letter is looking for someone else. Match the name to our customer.
pickup-nudge.heard: That letter is looking for someone else. Match the name to our customer.

pickup-success.text: Special delivery! You matched the name.
pickup-success.heard: Special delivery! You match the name!

next-customer.text: The bell is ringing. Another customer is coming.
next-customer.heard: The bell is ringing another customer is coming

shift-complete.text: Every letter found its person. You made the post office sparkle!
shift-complete.heard: Every letter found its person. You made the post office sparkle.

letter-a.text: Lowercase a. Around, close, then down.
letter-a.heard: Lowercase uh, around, close, then down.

letter-e.text: Lowercase e. Across, up, and around.
letter-e.heard: Lowercase E, across, up and around.

letter-i.text: Lowercase i. Down, then add the dot.
letter-i.heard: Lowercase i down, then add the dot.

letter-l.text: Lowercase l. Start at the top and go down.
letter-l.heard: Lowercase L. Start at the top and go down.

letter-n.text: Lowercase n. Down, up, over, and down.
letter-n.heard: Lowercase N, down, up, over, and down.

letter-r.text: Lowercase r. Down, up, and curve.
letter-r.heard: Lowercase R, down, up, and curve.

letter-s.text: Lowercase s. Curve one way, then the other.
letter-s.heard: Lowercase S curve one way, then the other.

letter-v.text: Lowercase v. Slant down, then slant up.
letter-v.heard: Lowercase V, slant down, then slant up.

letter-y.text: Lowercase y. Down, up, then swoop below.
letter-y.heard: Lower case we down up then swoop below
